environment.description: Kubernetes deployment in namespace 'messaging' running on EKS 1.28. Pod runs with default service account. No Istio sidecar injected (istio-injection=disabled on namespace). SQS queue accepts messages from any authenticated AWS principal with sqs:SendMessage. No input validation on message attributes at the queue level. JVM runs with no SecurityManager. Container image based on eclipse-temurin:17-jre with full network egress.
